text: Jordan spent the week before the September 24th portfolio presentation building out the Meridian and Coda case studies, and in reworking Coda discovered that months of journal entries had unintentionally formed a design log tracing the blind spot he missed and later understood—reshaping the story from a features list into something more honest, though he's unsure what to make of owing that insight to his own journaling. He's managing quiet anxieties around timing (Priya's intro chat on the 21st landing just before the Northlight onsite, and lingering fear from the 11th that hasn't dissipated), while leaning on small, low-effort support from Lena and finding steadiness in ordinary details like Pepper asleep on the rug. No major decisions were made beyond continuing to refine the presentation and consciously resisting getting attached to outcomes that haven't happened yet.
